blocks.text: There are no Gateway C0/C3 empirical outcomes in this artifact yet. The files below are design inputs and upstream references, not evidence that any hypothesis is supported. Archived OpenRouter/Novita and unversioned-Flash smoke records remain historical operational evidence only.

| ID | Item | Role | Location |
|---|---|---|---|
| E01 | Harvey LAB repository/architecture | task and official harness substrate | https://github.com/harveyai/harvey-labs |
| E02 | Harvey LAB v1.0 tutorial | execution/model adapter reference | https://github.com/harveyai/harvey-labs/blob/v1.0/docs/tutorial.md |
| E03 | Google agent-system architecture study | rationale for fixed centralized architecture | https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.08296 |
| E04 | ARA paper/repository | research-artifact management structure | https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24658 |
| E05 | Proofpress protocol/docs in this repository | portable artifact-lineage mechanism | `../../README.md` and `../../docs/` |

Future result entries must name the frozen configuration, task/source hash, fixed `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731` slug, Gateway adapter version, requested/resolved model, actual provider, Gateway `usage.cost`, fallback status/metadata, token/latency values, run records, scorer output, and any applicable Proofpress capsule verification record. The first planned entry is the PSA C0/C3 five-checkpoint serial-SAS slice `gateway-0731-harvey-psa-c0-c3-qualification-v1`, with a $25 shared actual-cost ceiling. Missing telemetry is an audit-visible failure of qualification, not a zero-cost observation. ARA indexes research meaning and evidence pointers; Proofpress supplies the C3 artifact-native admitted lineage and independent verification, never a benchmark agent's implicit memory or raw session transcript.
